findings.reason: The parse half of the [ac:ac-editorfactory-buduje-editorcontextspec-d] test goes through `buildMarkdownIt({ context })`, but `buildMarkdownIt` has no production caller. The page, brief and patch editors parse through tiptap-markdown's per-extension `parse.setup` (`RawJsxNode.setupFromOptions` reads `mountedTags` from `ctx.contextSpec`; `AnchorMarker` setup runs only when it is mounted). The new `context` option re-implements that gating in a second place that nothing in the app uses, while the test header says it parses 'the way each editor parses it'. Today the two paths agree, but if the real editor gating changes (for example raw_jsx `mountedTags` wiring, or anchor setup for `artifact`), this test stays green. The equivalence is safer if the test parses through an Editor built from `EditorFactory.buildExtensions('artifact', ctx)` (for example `editor.storage.markdown.parser`), or if it at least asserts on the `mountedTags` the factory configures on `raw_jsx_*`.

`PAGE_ROOT_LAYERS = rootEditorPropsForKind(PAGES_KIND)` duplicates `FULL_ROOT_EDITOR_PROPS` (contextSpec.ts:51, `rootEditorPropsForKind('pages')`), which is still the default `rootProps` of `EditorFactory.buildExtensions` and `getContextSpec`. That leaves two module-level constants with equal content and different identities for the same page layers, while the comment above them stresses that identity matters (useMemo deps / editor rebuild). Reuse the one constant, or rename `FULL_ROOT_EDITOR_PROPS` and drop the other, so the page editor and the factory default cannot drift apart.
